data.narrative:
FlyBy Robotics is a Seed-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Jason H. Lu and Cat Orman, having raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies in the Defense & Security sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression, using the $5M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $12M. Peer-Median triangulation across three same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A) yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: $11M (low), $206M (median), and $460M (high). The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median reflects material uncertainty around FlyBy's relative positioning within a highly dispersed peer cohort. Stage-Progression assumes baseline progression; Peer-Median captures outlier valuations in defense tech. Resolution hinges on clarity regarding FlyBy's differentiation, technical maturity, go-to-market traction, and defensibility relative to the peer set—particularly whether the company aligns with higher-valued outliers or earlier-stage peers.
